intake.label: What date is on the MC011 notice?
intake.why: The cover message names the account and the date.

intake.label: What is your eBay username?
intake.why: eBay matches documents to the username.

intake.label: Exactly which documents does the notice ask for?
intake.why: MC011 is a documents case, not an argument case. The checklist comes from eBay's own wording.

intake.label: Is the account registered as an individual or a business?
intake.why: The document set is different for each and a mismatch between registration and documents is the commonest failure.

intake.label: What is the exact legal name registered on the account?
intake.why: Every document must match this string character for character.

intake.label: What is the exact registered address on the account?
intake.why: Address mismatches across documents are the commonest cause of a second rejection.

intake.label: If you have already sent documents, what did eBay say was wrong?
intake.why: A resubmission that does not fix the stated reason gets the same answer.

intake.label: Who are the beneficial owners, and does the account list them all?
intake.why: A missing beneficial owner fails verification regardless of the documents.

intake.label: Does the name on your payout bank account match the legal name exactly?
intake.why: A bank account in a different name stops the payout release even after verification passes.

evidence.label: The MC011 notice
evidence.why: We build the checklist from eBay's own wording.

evidence.label: Business registration or Companies House document
evidence.why: Must show the exact legal name and address on the account.

evidence.label: Photo ID for each beneficial owner
evidence.why: Unexpired, full colour, whole document in frame.

evidence.label: Utility bill or bank statement dated in the last 90 days
evidence.why: Older documents are rejected without review.

evidence.label: Bank statement header showing the account name and number
evidence.why: Evidences the payout account belongs to the registered entity.

sections.heading: Document pack index
sections.guidance: Numbered list of attachments, each with what it evidences and the name and address exactly as they appear on it.

sections.heading: Cover message
sections.guidance: Short. Names the username, the MC011 date, what was rejected previously and how each document resolves it.

sections.heading: Consistency note
sections.guidance: One paragraph reconciling any difference in name or address across documents.

output.opening: One sentence naming the eBay username and the notice date.
output.closing: One line listing the attachments by filename.

rejection_patterns.check: The name on every confirmed document matches the registered legal name, or the difference is reconciled.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A name on one of your documents does not match the account. MC011 fails on this alone.

rejection_patterns.check: The address on every confirmed document matches the registered address, or the difference is reconciled.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An address on one of your documents does not match the account.

rejection_patterns.check: No address proof is dated more than 90 days before the notice.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This document is older than 90 days and will be rejected without review.

rejection_patterns.check: Every document named in the notice is present in the confirmed evidence.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A document eBay asked for has not been uploaded.

rejection_patterns.check: The documents match the account registration type.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: You have sent company documents for an account registered to an individual, or the reverse.

rejection_patterns.check: No [MISSING: ...] markers remain in the draft.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A required fact is missing. Answer the question or upload the document.

rejection_patterns.check: None of: unfortunately, I assure you, please give me one more chance, loyal seller, unfair.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This phrase appears in rejected appeals more than in accepted ones. Remove it.

rejection_patterns.check: No paragraph scores above 0.6 for genericity.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This paragraph could belong to any seller. A cover message that names nothing specific adds nothing.

rejection_patterns.check: All beneficial owners are covered by an ID document.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A missing beneficial owner fails verification regardless of the other documents.

rejection_patterns.check: No confirmed document was flagged unreadable or cropped during extraction.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: One of your scans was cropped or hard to read. Rescan the whole page in colour.

submission.where: The verification link in the MC011 email, or Seller Hub, Account, Verification
steps: Open the MC011 email and use the verification link it contains.
Upload each document as a full colour scan or photograph of the whole page.
Paste the cover message where the form allows a note.
Do not crop, redact or screenshot the documents.
submission.turnaround: eBay usually reviews verification documents within 2 to 5 business days. Payout release can take a further few days after the restriction lifts.
